name: Precia S.A.
summary: Precia S.A. specializes in the comprehensive development, manufacturing, sales, and servicing of diverse weighing solutions. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses industrial weighing scales, including crane scales, overhead scales, weighing bars, and pallet trucks, alongside laboratory balances, platform scales, and various load and wall receptors. The company also delivers advanced software and systems such as TRUCKFLOW, for weighbridge and in/out weighing management, integrated on-board weighing systems for industrial vehicles, and dynamic weight control solutions. For specialized applications, they provide tank weighing products, including process weighing load cells and indicators, as well as weighing stations for precise manual and automatic ingredient dosing within manufacturing formulas, along with average weight control systems. Precia offers a full suite of bulk weighing technologies: continuous weighing products like belt scales, weighing conveyors, speed measurement devices, and various controllers (including multi-station, modular, and single-station structures), supported by DATABULK BS continuous weighing supervision software; and discontinuous weighing solutions featuring automatic bulk scales, controllers, and indicators, further bolstered by DATABULK ABS automatic bulk scale software. Further expanding its offerings, Precia provides gravimetric, electronic, and volumetric bulk dosing systems, soft blending products, and specialized weighing equipment for hazardous environments. The company also offers PM connected services, smartphone applications like WEIGH2FLOW for conveyor flow analysis and WEIGH2CONTROL for centralized weighing monitoring, and dimensioning weighing scanning capabilities. Serving a global clientele, Precia S.A. caters to critical sectors including agribusiness, food processing, waste management, transport and logistics, and extractive industries. Established in 1887, the company maintains its headquarters in Privas, France.
